BTC.rationale: Most liquid/lowest single-asset-risk on the watchlist, steady +0.5% on the day rather than a single-session spike (avoided chasing HBAR/INJ's bigger 24h moves without RSI/MACD confirmation, which Robinhood's crypto data doesn't support). Sized at min(2% risk / 5% stop, 10% cap) of $19.01 = $1.90 per the documented sizing formula fix.
BTC.note: No native OCO/bracket order support in the crypto API -- resting stop-loss placed, but take-profit is NOT a resting order (a second resting sell would conflict with the stop). The hourly automated job must check price against take_profit_price and, if reached, cancel the stop-loss order and sell at market/limit.

notes: This is the real 'Agentic' Robinhood account, funded with real money on 2026-09-22. Governed by the same rules in paper_trading/strategy_notes.md: crypto only, no options, 2% risk / 10% max single-trade cap, real stop-loss on every position, no oversizing for 'bigger payouts.'
